# watchpoint_status_page_component (Resource)

One component on a status page. A component rolls up the health of the monitors attached to it, and is what a visitor sees listed as operational or degraded. Attach a third-party feed instead with `watchpoint_status_page_external_source`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_status_page_component" "api" {
  status_page_id   = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  name             = "Public API"
  description      = "REST and GraphQL endpoints"
  position         = 0
  aggregation_mode = "WorstOf"

  monitor_ids = [
    watchpoint_http_monitor.api_health.id,
    watchpoint_http_monitor.api_graphql.id,
  ]
}

resource "watchpoint_status_page_component" "dashboard" {
  status_page_id = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  name           = "Dashboard"
  position       = 1

  # The dashboard is unusable when the API is down, so an API outage explains
  # this component going red too.
  depends_on_component_ids = [watchpoint_status_page_component.api.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Component name shown to visitors, for example `API` or `Dashboard`.
- `status_page_id` (String) ID of the status page this component belongs to. Changing it replaces the component.

### Optional

- `aggregation_mode` (String) How the attached monitors roll up into one component health: `WorstOf` (as bad as the worst monitor), `AllFailed` (degraded only when every monitor is failing, for high-availability groups) or `Majority` (degraded once half or more are failing). Defaults to `WorstOf`.
- `depends_on_component_ids` (Set of String) Components on the same page this one depends on, used to explain a knock-on outage. Unordered. A component cannot depend on itself and the graph may not contain a cycle.
- `description` (String) Optional short description shown under the component name.
- `group_id` (String) `watchpoint_status_page_component_group` on the same page to list this component under. Omit to leave it ungrouped.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitors whose health this component reports. Unordered. Monitor IDs the tenant does not own are rejected by the API and will fail the apply.
- `position` (Number) Sort order on the page, ascending. Defaults to the end of the current list.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Component ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page_component.api page_001/component_001
```
